explanation.live: Each internal horizontal segment and the outside base form one triangle with the apex. Thus 4 internal levels make 4+1=5 triangles; option A.
explanation.canonical: Each internal horizontal segment and the outside base form one triangle with the apex. Thus 4 internal levels make 4+1=5 triangles; option A.
